records.source: The dark... the rain... it gets me excited.$l
records.translation: 黑暗……雨水……讓我興奮起來了。$l

records.source: Hey, remember when we played that duet by the lake? This weather reminds me of that day.#$e#You really surprised me with that mini-harp... I never expected that. I guess that's why I like you so much.$l
records.translation: 嘿，還記得我們在湖邊合奏嗎？這種天氣讓我想起了那一天。#$e#你拿出小豎琴時真的讓我大吃一驚……我完全沒料到。大概正因如此，我才那麼喜歡你。$l

records.source: Hey! I woke up early and did some exploring on my own. I found this and it reminded me of you. [768 767 769 66 82]#$e#Think you can find something better than that? I'm not so sure!$h
records.translation: 嘿！我很早就醒了，獨自出去探險。我找到這個，它讓我想起了你。 [768 767 769 66 82]#$e#你覺得自己能找到更好的東西嗎？我可不太確定！$h

records.source: It might be a good day to visit the caves, huh? Just be careful out there.#$e#If you go, bring a Life Elixir or two.
records.translation: 今天也許很適合去洞穴看看，對吧？在外面要小心。#$e#如果要去，帶上一兩瓶生命靈藥。

records.source: Maybe I'll boot up Journey Of The Prairie King today... one of these days I swear, I'll beat the whole game.$h
records.translation: 今天也許來玩《草原王之旅》……我發誓，總有一天會把整款遊戲破關。$h

records.source: %Abigail is lost in her music.
records.translation: %Abigail沉浸在音樂之中。

records.source: The countryside looks more interesting on a day like this, don't you think?
records.translation: 這樣的日子裡，鄉間看起來更有意思，你不覺得嗎？

records.source: I was just gazing out into the rainswept woods... I swear I saw something darker than black shifting around the trees.$6
records.translation: 我剛才一直凝望被雨水沖刷的樹林……我發誓看見某個比黑暗還要漆黑的東西在樹間移動。$6

records.source: It's a good night to see a ghost...
records.translation: 今晚很適合見鬼……

records.source: Can you feel it? There's a stillness in the rain...
records.translation: 你感覺到了嗎？雨中瀰漫著一片寂靜……

records.source: On nights like this, I like to turn the light down low and just listen...$8
records.translation: 像這樣的夜晚，我喜歡把燈光調暗，靜靜聆聽……$8

records.source: I felt like making some soup for dinner. I hope it's not too disgusting. [199 218 219 727 730]$h
records.translation: 我想煮些湯當晚餐。希望味道不會太噁心。 [199 218 219 727 730]$h

records.source: Hey! You look like you've been hard at work. Can I help you relax?^Have you been working hard? You look cute when you're a little exhausted.$h
records.translation: 嘿！你好像辛苦工作了很久。要我幫你放鬆一下嗎？^你一直在努力工作嗎？你有點疲憊的模樣很可愛。$h

records.source: The sound of rain should put us right to sleep tonight.
records.translation: 今晚的雨聲應該能讓我們立刻入睡。

records.source: I always loved this place, long before you moved in. Now I can explore the farm whenever I want!$h
records.translation: 早在你搬來以前，我就一直很喜歡這個地方。現在我隨時都能探索農場了！$h

records.source: Hey, @. Heading out into the wild? I got you something...[286 287 205 732]#$e#Use that if you get into a tough spot. It should help keep you safe.
records.translation: 嘿，@。要前往荒野嗎？我替你準備了點東西……[286 287 205 732]#$e#遇到危險時就用吧。它應該能保護你的安全。

records.source: Heading to the mines? Hey... if you find something tasty, remember to bring me a piece!$h
records.translation: 要去礦井嗎？嘿……如果找到好吃的東西，記得帶一塊給我！$h

records.source: Hey! I'm just debating what I should do today. I'm not used to having this much freedom!
records.translation: 嘿！我只是在猶豫今天該做什麼。我還不習慣擁有這麼多自由！

records.source: You don't mind if I do some re-decorating now and then, do you? I'm still excited to have a place of my own to work on.
records.translation: 你不介意我偶爾重新佈置一下吧？擁有一個能親手打造的地方，至今仍讓我很興奮。

records.source: There's always something new happening on our farm... I love it.
records.translation: 我們的農場總有新鮮事發生……我喜歡這樣。

records.source: I had a good day, today. There's always something interesting going on around here, if you look close enough.
records.translation: 我今天過得很好。只要仔細觀察，這附近總有有趣的事情發生。

records.source: Hey! Tell me about your day. Did anything exciting happen?$h
records.translation: 嘿！跟我說說你今天過得如何。有發生什麼刺激的事嗎？$h

records.source: I used to be a night owl, but I'm starting to enjoy the rhythm of life on the farm. It feels natural.
records.translation: 我以前是個夜貓子，但現在開始享受農場生活的節奏。感覺很自然。

records.source: *yawn*... I'm ready to call it a night pretty soon.$h
records.translation: *哈欠*……我很快就準備睡覺了。$h

records.source: The sounds of the night are louder out here. I'll never stop enjoying that.
records.translation: 這裡的夜晚聲響更加清晰。我永遠都會喜歡這一點。

records.source: Are you ready for bed soon? I turned on the electric blanket for us...$l
records.translation: 準備好待會兒睡覺了嗎？我替我們打開了電熱毯……$l

records.source: The soft breeze is blowing mountain air throughout the valley today. It smells like fresh pine and sage.
records.translation: 今天的微風把山間空氣吹遍整座山谷。聞起來有清新的松木和鼠尾草氣息。

records.source: Hmm... I think we've got plenty of space for outdoor slime ranching!
records.translation: 嗯……我想我們有足夠的空間在戶外養殖史萊姆！

records.source: Make sure to keep things tidy around your Grandpa's shrine. There's something special about it, I can feel it.
records.translation: 一定要維持爺爺神龕周圍的整潔。它有某種特別之處，我感覺得到。

records.source: It's pretty cool that we have a cave on our property. It's something I always dreamed about.$h
records.translation: 我們的土地上有座洞穴，真的很酷。這是我一直夢寐以求的事。$h

records.source: I always forget to put some snacks in my pocket. *rumble*$h
records.translation: 我總是忘記在口袋裡放點零食。*咕嚕*$h

records.source: I'm just going to hang out here, okay?#$e#There's a lot of interesting bugs and things out here. *chuckle*$h
records.translation: 我就在這裡待一會兒，好嗎？#$e#外面有很多有趣的蟲子和其他東西。*輕笑*$h

records.source: I'm going in to town today, just so you know. I need to stretch these legs a bit.
records.translation: 先跟你說一聲，我今天要進鎮上。我需要稍微活動一下雙腿。

records.source: Hey! Did you have a good day? Mine went well. It was refreshing to take a walk.$h
records.translation: 嘿！你今天過得好嗎？我過得很順利。出去散步讓人神清氣爽。$h

records.source: I can't believe I'm a "mom"... life is weird.$h
records.translation: 真不敢相信我成了「媽媽」……人生真奇妙。$h

records.source: I already gave %kid1 and %kid2 their chocolate cereal. They were screaming!
records.translation: 我已經給%kid1和%kid2吃過巧克力麥片了。他們剛才一直尖叫！

records.source: I had a dream that %kid2 will grow up to be a famous monster hunter. I've already been thinking about a little armor set.
records.translation: 我夢見%kid2長大後成了一位著名的怪物獵人。我已經開始構思一套小盔甲了。

records.source: A cool old house, a couple kids, and an amazing farm. I never thought I'd come this far... but, hey! Our lives are just getting started.$h
records.translation: 一棟很酷的老房子、兩個孩子，還有一座很棒的農場。我從沒想過自己能走到這一步……不過，嘿！我們的人生才正要開始。$h

records.source: Did you hear that? Sometimes I'm convinced this house is haunted.$u
records.translation: 你聽見了嗎？有時候我深信這棟房子在鬧鬼。$u

records.source: Welwick's horoscope predicted great things for me today. I feel really motivated!
records.translation: 韋爾維克的星座運勢預測我今天會遇到大好事。我感覺幹勁十足！

records.source: I can't even remember the last time I dyed my hair... I swear, it never fades from this color...
records.translation: 我甚至不記得上次染頭髮是什麼時候了……我發誓，這個顏色從來不會褪……

records.source: I'm glad I owned a heavy pair of boots before moving in. It's hard to imagine tip-toeing around the mud in sneakers.$h
records.translation: 幸好我搬來前就有一雙厚重的靴子。很難想像穿著運動鞋踮起腳尖走過泥地的樣子。$h

records.source: I was just admiring the mermaid's pendant you gave me... I'll proudly wear this to my grave.$l
records.translation: 我剛才在欣賞你送我的美人魚墜飾……我會驕傲地戴著它直到入土。$l

records.source: Hey. I know you're smart, but I still worry about you sometimes. The world is full of monsters.$6#$e#Just promise me you'll be careful. I don't want to lose you.
records.translation: 嘿。我知道你很聰明，但有時還是會擔心你。這個世界到處都是怪物。$6#$e#答應我一定要小心。我不想失去你。

records.source: @? I just want to say that I appreciate all the hard work you do for us. I'm really proud of you.$l
records.translation: @？我只想告訴你，我很感激你為我們辛苦付出的一切。我真的以你為榮。$l

records.source: I hope you'll still like me when I'm old and shriveled. It's going to happen some day!
records.translation: 希望等我老得皺巴巴時，你還是會喜歡我。總有一天會變成那樣的！

records.source: Do you think your Grandpa would be proud of us?
records.translation: 你覺得爺爺會為我們感到驕傲嗎？

records.source: I wonder how the old shop is doing? I should visit my parents again soon.
records.translation: 不知道老家的商店經營得如何？我應該盡快再去看看爸媽。

records.source: If you moved on to the spirit world, I'd set up a little shrine for you next to Grandpa's.
records.translation: 如果你去了靈界，我會在爺爺的神龕旁替你設一座小神龕。

records.source: No matter how much we clean, the house keeps getting dirty again.#$e#I guess farms are kind of dirty.
records.translation: 不管打掃多少次，房子總會再度變髒。#$e#我想農場本來就有點髒。

records.source: I wonder if we'll live here our entire lives? I might get bored.
records.translation: 不知道我們會不會一輩子都住在這裡？我也許會感到厭倦。

records.source: I used to be special to you, your best friend... now you only seem to put up with me when I make a hot dinner.$s
records.translation: 我曾經是你心中特別的人，是你最好的朋友……現在你好像只有在我煮好熱騰騰的晚餐時才願意忍受我。$s

records.source: You've been so cold to me lately... What's wrong with you? You're acting like a bog spirit...$s
records.translation: 你最近對我好冷淡……你怎麼了？你的表現簡直像沼澤幽靈……$s

records.source: I wonder if I could've done better... I was very good friends with Sebastian before we met. He was probably the one...$s
records.translation: 不知道我是不是能有更好的選擇……我們認識前，我和賽巴斯汀是非常要好的朋友。也許他才是命中注定的人……$s

records.source: So, do you have any big plans for the new year?
records.translation: 所以，你新的一年有什麼大計畫嗎？

records.source: Hey, the egg festival is tomorrow. I'm sorry, but I won't go easy on you because we're married!$h#$e#I plan on winning that egg hunt. Go ahead and try to beat me.
records.translation: 嘿，明天是彩蛋節。抱歉，就算我們結婚了，我也不會對你手下留情！$h#$e#我打算贏得那場尋蛋比賽。儘管試著打敗我吧。

records.source: Do you have any new year's resolutions? I'm trying to lose a few pounds around the middle.$h
records.translation: 你有什麼新年新希望嗎？我正試著減掉腰間的幾磅贅肉。$h

records.source: I get sunburnt very easily, so I need to be careful this time of year.#$e#I hope you like me pale!$h
records.translation: 我很容易曬傷，所以每年這個時候都得多加小心。#$e#希望你喜歡我蒼白的模樣！$h

records.source: Make sure you don't get a heat stroke, my love.#$e#Drink plenty of water and don't overwork yourself.
records.translation: 親愛的，千萬別中暑。#$e#多喝水，也別讓自己工作過度。

records.source: Sorry about the smell... I was sweating all night in the heat.
records.translation: 抱歉有股味道……天氣太熱，我整晚都在流汗。

records.source: It's summer... that means the house is full of flies.#$e#Don't worry, I'll take care of them. It's fun!$h
records.translation: 夏天到了……這表示家裡到處都是蒼蠅。#$e#別擔心，我會收拾牠們。這很好玩！$h

records.source: Ah... fall. This might be my favorite time of year. The colors really complement my hair, don't you think?
records.translation: 啊……秋天。這也許是我一年中最喜歡的時節。這些色彩真的很襯我的頭髮，你不覺得嗎？

records.source: The scent is unmistakable... mushroom, rotting leaves, pumpkin. It's fall, alright. Isn't it lovely?
records.translation: 這股氣味絕不會認錯……蘑菇、腐爛的落葉、南瓜。確實是秋天。是不是很美好？

records.source: Can we grow giant pumpkins this season? Please, honey?$h
records.translation: 這一季我們可以種出巨大南瓜嗎？拜託啦，親愛的？$h

records.source: Honey... you're worth more to me than a chest full of quartz.#$e#Now, a chest full of amethyst? Hmm... I'd have to think about that one.$h
records.translation: 親愛的……對我來說，你比一整箱石英更珍貴。#$e#不過，要是一整箱紫水晶呢？嗯……那我得考慮一下。$h

records.source: I actually like the cold weather. It just gives me an excuse to get cozy!$h
records.translation: 其實我喜歡寒冷的天氣。這正好讓我有藉口窩得暖暖的！$h

records.source: It's fun to explore the valley in winter! Everything is so different under a blanket of snow. And so quiet...
records.translation: 冬天探索山谷很好玩！蓋上一層白雪後，每樣東西都截然不同。而且如此安靜……

records.source: I may like the colder seasons, but by the end I'm always glad to see spring arrive.
records.translation: 我也許喜歡寒冷的季節，但到了季末，總會很高興看見春天來臨。

records.source: Oh man... I could go for some chocolate cake.
records.translation: 天啊……真想吃點巧克力蛋糕。

records.source: Do I smell pumpkin on you? Maybe I'm just dreaming...$h
records.translation: 你身上有南瓜的味道嗎？也許我只是在作夢……$h

records.source: Remember when we played 'Prairie King' together in my room, so long ago? Those were good times.$h
records.translation: 還記得很久以前，我們在我房間裡一起玩《草原王之旅》嗎？那真是一段美好時光。$h

records.source: #$c .5#I got up a little before you and fed David Jr. He's very active this morning.#$e#I hope you don't mind the guinea pig smell.
records.translation: #$c .5#我比你早起了一點，還餵了小大衛。牠今天早上非常活躍。#$e#希望你不介意天竺鼠的氣味。
